definitions.gloss: windfall; unexpected good luck; lucky break
definitions.explanation: Good fortune that arrives with no effort on one's part. It is a shortening of the proverb {棚|たな}から{牡丹餅|ぼたもち} ("a botamochi falling from the shelf").

examples.japanese: {棚|たな}ぼたで{一位|いちい}になった。
examples.english: I ended up in first place by a stroke of luck.

examples.japanese: ライバルの{棄権|きけん}で、{棚|たな}ぼたの{優勝|ゆうしょう}が{転|ころ}がり{込|こ}んだ。
examples.english: With my rival's withdrawal, an unexpected championship fell right into my lap.

notes:
An abbreviation of the proverb {棚|たな}から{牡丹餅|ぼたもち}. Often written in kana or mixed kana-kanji as {棚|たな}ぼた.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {棚|たな}ぼた{式|しき}: windfall-style; effortlessly obtained
- {棚|たな}ぼたの{勝利|しょうり}: a lucky win
- {棚|たな}ぼたを{狙|ねら}う: to hope for a lucky break

NUANCE: Can carry a faint hint of criticism, implying the result owed more to luck than to effort.
